LESSON: READING 5.2.1 STUDY SKILLS- REFERENCE MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials, part of Strand 5 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of reference materials? 2. How can one use reference materials appropriately?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. pick out various words from print and digital texts,

2. check the meanings and spellings of the words in a dictionary,

3. work with peers to look for the synonyms of various words from a thesaurus,

4. construct sentences using the given words,

5. give the antonyms of those words,

6. use an encyclopaedia to search for information on various topics,

7. create crossword puzzles using the antonyms and synonyms learnt and share with peers for review. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. pick out various words from print and digital texts,
2. check the meanings and spellings of the words in a dictionary,
3. work with peers to look for the synonyms of various words from a thesaurus,
4. construct sentences using the given words,
5. give the antonyms of those words,
6. use an encyclopaedia to search for information on various topics,
7. create crossword puzzles using the antonyms and synonyms learnt and share with peers for review. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Study Skills- Reference Materials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self- efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner gathers information from different reference materials.

• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner recognises the value of others’ ideas while searching for antonyms and

synonyms.

Values:
Respect: It is promoted as the learner appreciates others while reviewing their crossword puzzles on the antonyms and

synonyms.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peaceful conflict resolution: It is inculcated as the learner creates and shares with peers their crossword puzzles on antonyms

and synonyms learnt, for review.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of effective use of reference materials to library use in Pre-technical Studies.
